in_hebrew.name: Galan
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Galan הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Greek mythology, Galan was an epithet for the god Apollo, representing the idea of leading and ruling. In a Christian context, the name Galan can symbolize leadership, guidance, and protection.
